meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 cobrapy 读取和构建代谢模型，执行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样、最小培养基等模拟，输出生长速率、通量范围等数值结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求加载或构建代谢模型、做 FBA/FVA/通量采样/基因敲除/培养基优化/模型补全等 COBRA 分析时触发。

say.text: 用 FBA 算一下这个模型的生长速率
say.note: 会运行 optimize 并返回目标值

say.text: 对模型做单基因敲除筛选
say.note: 返回各基因敲除后的生长结果
返回需要的交换反应和参考通量

howto.what_en: Claude will use cobrapy to load or build metabolic models, run FBA, FVA, flux sampling, gene knockouts, minimal medium, and other simulations, returning growth rates, flux ranges, and related numerical results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to load/build metabolic models, or to run FBA, FVA, flux sampling, knockout screens, media optimization, or gap-filling.

say_en.text: Run FBA on this model and give the growth rate.
say_en.note: Runs optimize and returns objective value.

say_en.text: Compute a minimal medium for this model.
say_en.note: Returns required exchange reactions and fluxes.
